description: This PHP class 'CandidateActionHistory' provides methods to retrieve candidate action history IDs, including filtering for interviewer-specific actions, based on mappings defined in 'CandidateService' and 'WorkflowStateMachine'. It is part of the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin, specifically within the DTO (Data Transfer Object) namespace.

classes.name: CandidateActionHistory
classes.description: A DTO class that provides methods to retrieve candidate action history IDs and filter actions relevant to interviewers.

methods.name: getAccessibleCandidateActionHistoryIds
methods.description: Returns an array of candidate action history IDs based on combined mappings of statuses and actions.

methods.name: getAccessibleCandidateHistoryIdsForInterviewer
methods.description: Returns an array of candidate action history IDs, excluding specific actions like offer, decline, hire, and reject, suitable for interviewer views.
